categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Chipmore Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the integrated circuit advanced packaging and testing industry. Its main business segments include packaging and testing services for display driver chips and non-display chips such as power management and RF front-end chips. The company offers turnkey services covering bumping, wafer testing, flip-chip packaging, and final chip testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies in bumping (gold bumping, copper pillar bumping, copper-nickel-gold bumping, tin bumping), wafer testing automation, and advanced packaging techniques including COF, COG/COP, and large-area flip-chip packaging. It also focuses on high-precision wafer grinding, redistribution layer (RDL) technology, and front-side metallization (FSM) and back-side grinding/metalization (BGBM) for power ICs. Production follows a make-to-order model with stages from pilot runs to mass production, supported by MES systems and strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves integrated circuit design companies (fabless) primarily in the display driver chip market, including clients in smartphones, TVs, laptops, and automotive displays. It also serves customers in power management and RF front-end chip sectors. Key customers include well-known domestic and international IC design firms such as Novatek, FocalTech, Himax, and others. The company targets markets driven by emerging technologies like AI, 5G, IoT, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly based in China with headquarters in Hefei and a subsidiary in Suzhou. The company also maintains a sales office in Taiwan to support local customers. Its sales are divided between domestic (China mainland) and overseas markets, with domestic revenue growing faster. Hefei and the Yangtze River Delta region provide strategic industrial clusters and supply chain advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chipmore operates in the midstream to downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as an OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) provider. It receives wafers from foundries and provides advanced packaging and testing services before the chips are delivered to downstream manufacturers for final product assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance core technologies in bumping, wafer testing, and advanced packaging. It is expanding its product portfolio, especially in AMOLED display driver chips and non-display chip packaging. Strategic R&D projects focus on high-density bumping, large-area flip-chip packaging, wafer-level cutting, automotive-grade packaging, and efficient heat dissipation technologies. The company also invests in talent development and collaborates closely with customers for early-stage product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized integrated circuit packaging and testing services. The company operates on a direct sales model, providing turnkey packaging and testing solutions to fabless IC design companies. Income is recognized at the point of transfer of control of goods or services, typically upon shipment or delivery to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chipmore is a leading domestic player in the advanced packaging and testing of display driver chips, ranking first in China and third globally in this segment. It competes with industry leaders such as JCET, Tongfu Microelectronics, and ASE Technology. While it has a strong niche in display driver chip packaging, it is expanding into non-display chip markets to compete with larger integrated OSAT providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.96 billion, a 20.26% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 313 million, down 15.71% from the previous year. R&D investment increased by 45.53% to RMB 154.7 million. The company has total assets of about RMB 7 billion and equity of RMB 6 billion, with steady growth in production volumes and cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chipmore differentiates itself through advanced proprietary bumping and packaging technologies, high product quality with yields above 99.95%, and comprehensive turnkey services covering the entire packaging and testing process. Its geographic location in Hefei and Suzhou offers supply chain and logistics advantages. The company emphasizes close customer collaboration, rapid response to market trends, and continuous innovation to meet high-performance, high-reliability packaging needs in emerging applications like AMOLED displays, automotive electronics, and 5G.
